We need answer JSON only. Need evaluate all 60 stories for Minimal criterion. Need be careful. QUS Minimal: user story contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information external to story sentence. Scope individual. Need evaluate each story from own text. Backlog stories mostly simple "As a ..., I want to ... [so that ...]" no extra. Need identify violations if any. Need return exactly 60 objects. We need ensure each story ID once. Let's parse all. Most minimal, no extra notes. Some have typos "automatically validated" etc but not extra info. Need decide.

Criterion "Minimal" individual: contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. The "As a... I want..." stories. Are there any with extra? Let's inspect.

ZO-001 As a user, I want to search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting. Role, means. No extra. No violation.

ZO-002 similar.
ZO-003 similar.
ZO-004 "As a user, I want to search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity." Role means. No extra.

ZO-005 "As a user, I want to search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path." Role means ends. Minimal okay.

ZO-006 "As a user, I want to upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps." Role means. "and have tags available..." Could be multiple means but still means. Minimal.

ZO-007 view thumbnail sequences.
ZO-008 get info.
ZO-009 get info.
ZO-010 receive content recommendations.
ZO-011 receive content recommendations based on...
ZO-012 identify persons and receive info. Role means maybe two means in one sentence, still minimal? Minimal says nothing more than role, means, optional ends. Combining means is fine.
ZO-013,14,15 similar.
ZO-016 "As a user, I want to take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image." role means ends.
ZO-017 "As a user, I want to walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest." role means. Maybe "walk around" and "access" etc. Still role means, no extras.

ZO-018 search content items using ASR.

Admin stories 19-26 simple.

ZO-027 "As a Zooniverse admin, I want to assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk." Means. mentions implementation? "based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk" are criteria for assessment, not necessarily implementation hints. Minimal? Could be considered means details. Is it "nothing more than role, means"? Means can include specifics. Not violation. Need compare with operational rule: Violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information external to story sentence. It doesn't include comments but mentions "comments on Talk" as data source. That's domain info, not implementation/testing hint. No violation.

ZO-028 "detect when scientist should be prompted to look at subject, based on annotations and information from Talk comments." Means. No extra.

ZO-029 identify volunteer types.
ZO-030 preclassify Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features. Means. "using simple low-level image features" could be implementation hint? Hmm User story is "As a Zooniverse admin, I want to preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features." This states how to achieve via low-level image features. Is that implementation detail? Minimal criterion says contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. It does contain means including using low-level image features. Is "using simple low-level image features" an implementation/testing hint or perhaps means? We need interpret. A user story normally should not include solution/implementation details. But QUS Minimal specifically not include implementation hints. "using simple low-level image features" is a technical approach, possibly implementation detail. But does this story violate Minimal? It still is within a single sentence "I want to do X using Y." Means includes "using". QUS definition: role, means, optional ends/rationale. "means" is what user wants to achieve maybe can include how? Actually in user story, "means" is functionality or action. But using specific technology can be an implementation hint. Need determine if any stories in backlog violate.

The examples: "A story followed by mock-up notes and step-by-step validation instructions violates Minimal because those notes are extra to role, means, and ends." That is about extra notes, not about solution details in sentence. Operational rule: "comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence." It says implementation/testing hints included. "using simple low-level image features" might be implementation hint. Similarly "using content identification or fingerprinting" might be implementation tech. But all stories have "using" clauses. Should we classify as violation? Need scrutinize.

Lucassen et al Minimal: A user story "contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale." Violation includes "comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other information that should be external to the story sentence." The target is "core story" not extra text. If a story sentence itself includes implementation/testing hints, likely violates Minimal. But many backlog stories include methods/technical hints. However, the criterion's operational decision rule may be about extra information beyond the story sentence. But examples mention story followed by notes. The definition "contains nothing more than role, means, and optional ends/rationale" could also encompass technical solution in means? Not necessarily: a means can be "search using tags" not implementation? Hmm.
